name: Last-mile and courier transportation management software
statusNote: Last-mile courier and delivery-management market. The channels are real and verified. The keyword sets have NOT been run against live hit rates, so treat the first two sweeps as calibration and expect to cut the qualifier list. Do not present this pack's yield as comparable to a proven pack.

buyerProfile.note: Two distinct buyers, and they behave differently. Keep them apart when reading results.

buyers.description: The courier, 3PL, LTL or distribution business buying a TMS to run its own operation. Mostly private, rarely posts a public RFP, and is reached through sales rather than a sweep.

The hospital, health authority, pharmacy chain, retailer, grocer or public body buying delivery capability, and increasingly the software that runs it. This is the buyer that posts publicly, and it is what this pack sweeps for.

channels.note: Structured open data with full descriptions.
Has a public Opportunities API. Use the API, not the UI. Highest-signal channel for this pack.
State, local and education. Where US hospital and municipal courier RFPs surface.
Add only the states the tenant sells into. Do not enable all 50.

directSites.note: Health authority and hospital group procurement pages, and the large pharmacy and grocery chains. These publish on their own sites as often as on a portal.

must: the solicitation buys software, or a delivery service where the software platform is evaluated
scope is last-mile, courier, or final-mile rather than long-haul freight

thresholds.note: US federal postings above the micro-purchase and simplified acquisition floors reach SAM.gov. Canadian figures are the same trade-agreement thresholds as every other industry. Verify the current US figures with the tenant's capture lead before relying on them; they are indexed and move.

values.appliesTo: BC, AB, SK, MB goods and services

scoring.weightsNote: incumbent is weighted higher than the education and nonprofit packs. Last-mile contracts are re-competed on a cycle and the incumbent carrier or platform is usually named in the solicitation, which is a stronger signal here than in K-12.

openQuestions: Which US states does the merged entity actually sell into? The pack enables us.state.portals but names none.
Is there an existing customer list to seed data/lastmile-shipper-watch.json? A tenant's installed-base watch list is usually its highest-yield channel.
